title: Semantic theme tokens
description: Framework-neutral light and dark CSS variables for consistent project branding without changing feature behavior.

notes: Requires CSS custom properties. Does not apply a global reset or automatically select a color scheme.

configuration: Override --gl-* variables after this stylesheet or within a scoped theme container.
Set data-genlib-theme to light or dark on a container or the document root.
limitations: No theme persistence, theme-toggle JavaScript, font downloads, or automatic OS-theme detection.
Validate contrast again after project-specific token overrides.
